title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(芦野慎研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Ashino Makoto)
keywords: Research & Development 2.Scanning Probe Microscopy 3.Vacuum & Electron Control 4.Carbon Nano Structures 5.Search for Novel Functionalities
educationalGoal: Students will learn : (1) framework of research activities involving “Team Work”, “Academic Planning”, basic skills of “Measurements” and “Instrumentations, (2) characteristics of “Nanotechnology”, “Surface Science”, and “Solid State Physics”, and “Graphene and Carbon Nanostructures”, so that they could perform bsic research activities to develop next-generation devices.
advice: This is the final course of “Design Project”. Students will achieve some basic skills toward the following research activities: 1. Development of novel scanning methods and instrumentation on Scanning Probe Microcopy 2. Manufacturing novel carbon nano-architectures for next generation electronic and smart energy devices 3. Three-dimensional imaging of carbon nano-architectures by Scanning Probe Microscope 4. Evaluations and characterizations of carbon nano-architecture
books: Textbooks: Reference books:Noncontact atomic force microscopy, vol. 3 [Springer] Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Mathematics, Physics, Electric and Electronic Circuits, Electromagnetism, Feedback Control, Physical Electronics. Some basic skills of metal working, computer programing with C language, and English reading.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand what needs for research activities and make their plans.
Be able to communicate well to tutor and team mates in order to make a good progress.
Be able to speedy and accurately obtain required information and to find a clue of solution.
Be able to find solutions to resolve some issues and problems by themselves.
Be able to explain research activities and make effective presentations on them.
Be able to summarize research activities in a design project report

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけ
